question.text: Is R a subset from the cartesian product X × Y?

answers.answer: Yes, R is a subset of X × Y because every ordered pair in R has its first element in X and its second element in Y.
solution: R = {(a, Science), (a, Culture), (b, History), (c, Literature), (e, History)}.
X × Y is the set of all ordered pairs with first projection in X and second projection in Y.
Each pair of R has its first element in X (a, b, c, e) and its second element in Y.
So every element of R is in X × Y.
Therefore $R\subset X\times Y$. Yes.

checks.resolve_answer: Yes. Every ordered pair in R has its first element in X and its second element in Y, so $R\subset X\times Y$.
